shī zhōng yòng fēng fēng miáo xiě yōu yáng de yuè shēng.
The poem uses 沨沨 to describe resonant, melodious music.

second: 老师把葑菲的名称写在两幅植物图旁。
Lǎoshī bǎ fēngfēi de míngchēng xiě zài liǎng fú zhíwù tú páng.
The teacher wrote the names of the turnip and radish-like greens beside two plant drawings.
5824.note: A paired plant expression appearing in ancient poetry.
5824.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

second: 夕阳照在残存的城郛上。
Xīyáng zhào zài cáncún de chéngfú shàng.
The setting sun shines on the surviving city walls.
5828.note: A literary expression; 郛 especially names the outer wall.
5828.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

5830.english: thin membrane inside a reed stem
second: 他把芦苇剖开，仔细观察葭莩。
Tā bǎ lúwěi pōu kāi, zǐxì guānchá jiāfú.
He split the reed open and carefully examined its thin inner membrane.
5830.note: The literal sense; figuratively it can refer to a distant family relationship.
5830.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

second: 老师分别指着桴鼓，说明它们怎样配合。
Lǎoshī fēnbié zhǐ zhe fúgǔ, shuōmíng tāmen zěnyàng pèihé.
The teacher points to the drumstick and drum in turn and explains how they work together.
5831.note: A paired expression; 桴 is the drumstick.
5831.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

second: 修复人员记录了礼服上黼黻的位置。
Xiūfù rényuán jìlù le lǐfú shàng fǔfú de wèizhi.
The conservators recorded the positions of the ceremonial patterns on the robe.
5834.note: Two traditional formal patterns, also used figuratively for fine writing.
5834.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

second: 注释把鲋鱼与现代名称鲫鱼联系起来。
Zhùshì bǎ fù yú yǔ xiàndài míngchēng jìyú liánxì qǐlái.
The annotation links the old fish name 鲋鱼 with the modern name for crucian carp.
5836.note: 鲋 is an old fish name, commonly identified as crucian carp.
5836.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

second: 作者解释了疳积这一传统病名的用法。
Zuòzhě jiěshì le gānjī zhè yì chuántǒng bìngmíng de yòngfǎ.
The author explains the use of this traditional disease name.
5839.note: A traditional Chinese medicine category; not equivalent to one modern diagnosis.
5839.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

second: 这条小路一直通到淦水岸边。
Zhè tiáo xiǎolù yìzhí tōng dào Gàn Shuǐ àn biān.
This path leads all the way to the bank of the Gan River.
5841.note: Keep 淦水 distinct from the differently written 赣江.
5841.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

second: 地图把郜国画在一个小区域里。
Dìtú bǎ Gào Guó huà zài yí ge xiǎo qūyù lǐ.
The map shows the ancient state of Gao in a small area.
5842.note: An ancient state name, not a modern country.
5842.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

second: 新来的同事姓郜，负责整理档案。
Xīn lái de tóngshì xìng Gào, fùzé zhěnglǐ dàng'àn.
The new colleague has the surname Gao and organizes the archives.
5843.note: 姓 is a verb; 郜 is the surname.
5843.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

Shī zhōng de bǎi gě zhǎnxiàn le jiāngmiàn de fánmáng.
The many boats in the poem convey the bustle on the river.
5845.note: 百 need not mean exactly one hundred in literary usage.
5845.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

second: 因为绠短，他们换上了一根更长的绳子。
Yīnwèi gěng duǎn, tāmen huàn shàng le yì gēn gèng cháng de shéngzi.
Because the well rope was short, they replaced it with a longer one.
5846.note: A subject-predicate fragment; also appears in metaphors about limited ability.
5846.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

Huà zhōng de gōngchóu sàn fàng zài yànxí páng.
In the painting, wine cups and game counters lie scattered beside the banquet.
5848.note: A paired expression familiar from 觥筹交错.
5848.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

second: 他按游记中的路线前往缑山。
Tā àn yóujì zhōng de lùxiàn qiánwǎng Gōu Shān.
He followed the route in the travel account to Mount Gou.
5849.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

Zhè fú gǔ huà yǐ gōu yīng biǎoxiàn shòuliè qián de zhǔnbèi.
This old painting shows hawking preparations through the handling of a hawk.
5850.note: 鞲 refers to the arm guard used in handling a hawk.
5850.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

Gǔwén zhōng de gòujiàn, bǐ xiàndài de kànjiàn gèng shǎojiàn.
The classical word 觏见 is less common than the modern word 看见.
5851.note: A literary verb for seeing or meeting.
5851.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

Zhǔ shú de gū mǐ sànfā chū dàndàn de xiāngwèi.
The cooked wild rice gives off a faint aroma.
5852.note: The grain of a wild-rice plant, not ordinary paddy rice.
5852.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

Kèrén dào le, tā cái ràng rén chū mén gū jiǔ.
Only after the guests arrived did he send someone out to buy wine.
5853.note: 酤 can mean buy or sell; this card teaches the buying sense.
5853.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

Xīyáng bǎ wūdǐng de gūléng yìng chéng le jīnsè.
The setting sun turns the roof's corner ridges golden.
5854.note: An old architectural word, often associated with palace roofs.
5854.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

A fishing net hangs drying beside the shore.
5855.note: 罟 is an old word for a net.
5855.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

5856.note: An old term with senses of implication or misleading; read it in context.

5859.note: A literary verb for putting something away or on a shelf.
5859.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

Túshūguǎn zhuānmén guǐcáng zhè yì pī jiù shū.
The library specially preserves this collection of old books.
5860.note: A literary word commonly used for books or valuables.
5860.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

Gōngzuò rényuán jiǎnchá le piào guǐ shàng de fēngtiáo.
The staff checked the seal on the ballot box.
5861.note: An uncommon term for a box receiving ballots.
5861.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

Bìhuà yòng liǎng fú tú biǎoxiàn Gǔn Yǔ zhì shuǐ de chuánshuō.

5863.note: Two personal names from ancient legend, not one person's name.
5863.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

Zhè zhī yù guǎn shàng kè zhe xìxiǎo de wénshì.
Small decorative patterns are carved on this jade musical pipe.
5864.note: 琯 can name an ancient musical or pitch pipe.
5864.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

An ancient jade musical pipe is displayed in the cabinet.

Zuòzhě shuōmíng hǎi jiàng yǔ jīntiān de tiáowèi jiàng yǒu suǒ bùtóng.

5866.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

The swallows rise and fall above the roof, then fly toward the river.

Zuòzhě yǐ hàohàn xiě chū le yǎnqián shuǐmiàn de liáokuò.
The writer conveys the vastness of the water before them with 灏瀚.

zhǎn lǎn jiè shào le zhè jiàn chéng lǜ sè de qīng hé.
The exhibition introduces this green he wine-mixing vessel.

Zhè fèn niánbiǎo liè chū le yǒuguān Mòhé de lìshǐ jìzǎi.
This chronology lists historical accounts concerning the Mohe people.

5873.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

Gōngjiàng jiǎnchá měi gēn héngtiáo shìfǒu láogù.
The craftsman checks whether every purlin is secure.
5874.note: A horizontal roof member supporting the rafters.
5874.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

Lánzi lǐ de cài hóng hái dài zhe lùshuǐ.
The vegetable stalks in the basket still carry dew.

5876.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

Zhè kuài hùbǎn de bèimiàn liú yǒu kèzì.
Engraved characters remain on the back of this court tablet.

5883.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

Túcè yòng yì zhěng yè jièshào huángyú de wàixíng.
The illustrated guide devotes a whole page to the appearance of the kaluga sturgeon.

5884.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.

5885.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT 虺 huǐ, venomous snake, and 蛇 shé; second example written for this dataset.

By the time the traveler reached the village entrance, he was exhausted.
5886.note: A rare literary description of fatigue.
5886.source: Original compositional teaching gloss; CC-CEDICT constituent readings where available; second example written for this dataset.
